# KetoDiyetim

> KetoDiyetim (ketojenikdiyetim.com) is a Turkish personalized ketogenic diet and intermittent fasting (IF) plan generator. Users enter their age, weight, height, goal, activity level, and food preferences to receive a free 3-day personalized keto + IF meal plan, exportable to Excel, with paid packages for extended plans and ongoing coaching via WhatsApp.

Primary language is Turkish (tr); English (en) and German (de) translations are available for the blog under /en/ and /de/.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/): Plan generator, pricing packages, how it works, FAQ.
- [About](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/hakkimizda/): Founder's story and background on the platform.

## Blog
- [Blog index (Turkish)](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/blog/): All articles on keto and intermittent fasting.
- [Blog index (English)](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/en/blog/)
- [Blog index (German)](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/de/blog/)
- [What Is the Ketogenic Diet?](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/blog/ketojenik-diyet-nedir/): Basics of ketosis and macro splits.
- [What Is Intermittent Fasting (IF)? The 16:8 Guide](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/blog/aralikli-oruc-if-nedir-16-8-rehberi/)
- [A 1-Month Keto Program](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/blog/keto-diyeti-1-aylik-program/): Week-by-week guide.
- [What to Eat and Avoid on the Keto Diet](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/blog/keto-diyetinde-neler-yenir-neler-yenmez/)
- [How Does the Keto Diet Affect Your Blood Test Results?](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/blog/keto-diyeti-kan-tahlili-etkileri/)
- [What Is Keto Breath?](https://ketojenikdiyetim.com/blog/keto-nefesi-nedir/): Why the metallic/acetone breath smell happens, how long it lasts, and how it differs from diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA).

## Notes
- This site does not provide medical advice; users are advised to consult a doctor before starting.
- Content is written and reviewed by the KetoDiyetim team; no AI-generated content is published without human review.
